notes.content: Yet again fixed more bugs, it should now properly unlock when you reach the checkpoints, 2,4 and 6, rather than when beating it and reaching 3,5 and 7.

notes.title: Patchnotes for 1.30
notes.content: Added a checkpoint function to the game. Now by reaching checkpoint 2, 4 and 6, you are able to continue from them next time you play the game.

notes.title: Minipatch 2/4/2024
notes.content: More minor tweaks to balance the game due to player feedback.

notes.title: Minipatch 1.21
notes.content:
-Added colour blind mode, hit V to enable the "Ready" text.

-Fixed a bunch of areas where the player could "U" to get to another platform.

-Made some areas easier, and some harder.

notes.title: Patchnotes for 1.18
notes.content:
Added a key to mute the music - M
Added a key to hide the hints - H

Reworked level 7.
Major fixes to prevent the player being able to get outside of the map.

A bunch of other minor tweaks and fixes.
